decisions.decision: Credit approval is a separate single-use aggregate bound to Order resourceVersion, Payment Plan resourceVersion, server-evaluated Money, policyVersion and evaluationFingerprint. No wall-clock expiry is invented; any binding change supersedes it. Confirmation consumes APPROVED evidence atomically.

Accepted Quote conversion is a separate server-assigned Order creation command. It copies immutable commercial snapshots and enforces one durable Order per Quote. Direct-sale order creation remains blocked under the old generic order.create command.
decisions.currentResolution: DEC-P07-DIRECT-ORDER-DRAFT later closed direct-sale Order draft creation as createOrderDraftCommand.

decisions.decision: The Return saga never automatically reverses or consumes Customer-Credit-backed allocations. It persists MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED with typed blocker evidence. Payment-backed allocation reversal remains backend-owned.

decisions.question: Define provider attempt identity, cancellation acknowledgement window, retry linkage, same-key retention and terminal recovery guarantees. RefundIntent states alone are insufficient evidence.
decisions.currentResolution: Superseded by the P0.8 asynchronous requestRefundCancellation and retryRefundIntent contract.
